Subject: Quick: AWS co-sell registration & PDM/PSM intro for CloudTriangle opportunity

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — I’m Sarah, Channel Lead at AnglePoint. We’re working with CloudTriangle (large SaaS in logistics) on an AWS marketplace deal; they’re very interested in Redwood for low-latency inference on GPU-backed deployments. AWS ACE registration and a formal PDM/PSM intro will materially help the co-sell handoff.

High level: CloudTriangle is evaluating a pilot for anomaly detection + reranking across 3 regional clusters (us-west/us-east/eu-west). Expected initial ARR if successful: ~$420k ARR year 1. Procurement is already engaged with a preliminary SOW.

Can you start ACE registration and loop in PDM/PSM for a short technical sync next week? I’ve attached a one-pager and a high-level architecture slide.

Attachments: anglepoint-oppty-deck.pdf (1 page, PDF)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through.

—Sarah

Appreciate the context — I’ll run the technical sync and draft a short mutual action plan (MAP). Initial asks from my side:
1) Full AWS account ID + IAM contact (required for ACE)
2) Representative sample of expected input sizes and sequence lengths for the anomaly models (a short CSV is fine)
3) Any existing infra constraints (must be on VPC? compliance needs?)

For clarity I’m attaching a quick scope workbook and a short tech requirements doc — these will speed the sync and avoid a long discovery call. Proposed agenda for Thurs 11/19 (30–45m):
- 10m: goal framing & success criteria (CloudTriangle)
- 15m: infra & security constraints (CloudTriangle, procurement)
- 10m: Redwood recommended topology & ACE variant
- 5–10m: next steps & tentative dates for onboarding/PO/SOW

Attachments: mp-technical-scope.xlsx, technical_requirements.pdf

If procurement will want an SLA addendum or specific retention language, flag it now so we can surface to legal.

Thanks — I’ll hold Thurs 11/19 11:00–12:00 PT as a tentative slot; Sarah / Rohan, please confirm or propose alternatives.

—Marissa
